verdict.rationale: Brex documents automation features (AI invoice processing, GL coding, auto-enforced budget controls) and integrations with Pipedream and Zapier. None of the evidence shows versioning, review/diff, or rollback of those automations. Third-party low-code platforms are user-side or host-platform workarounds and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
